P201  NERD-TEXT 201   12.11.26 14:49 UTC
========================================
SECURITY ADVISORY (1/5)                 
========================================
> CVE-2026-124194                       
  MS Outlook: Network Spoofing Flaw     
                                        
  CISA added an active spoofing flaw in 
  Microsoft Outlook to its catalog.     
  Remote unauthenticated actors can     
  exploit missing user interaction      
  checks to forge data across networks. 
  Patch due Nov 24.                     
                                        
  CISA KEV | Added: 2026-11-10 | Due:   
  2026-11-24                            
[100] Index  [200] Prev  [202] Next

P202  NERD-TEXT 202   12.11.26 14:49 UTC
========================================
SECURITY ADVISORY (2/5)                 
========================================
> CVE-2026-111793                       
  Openwave: Media Transcoder Flaw       
                                        
  CISA flags an incorrect resource      
  transfer bug in Openwave Webtop Media 
  Transcoder. Authenticated attackers   
  can bypass security boundaries to     
  convert arbitrary document types.     
  Remediate by Nov 24.                  
                                        
  CISA KEV | Added: 2026-11-10 | Due:   
  2026-11-24

========================================
SECURITY ADVISORY (3/5)                 
========================================
> CVE-2026-20320                        
  Cisco: BroadWorks XXE Data Leak       
                                        
  A critical XXE vulnerability in Cisco 
  BroadWorks allows unauthenticated     
  remote adversaries to steal sensitive 
  configuration files. CISA ordered     
  federal agencies to apply vendor      
  updates by Nov 24.                    
                                        
  CISA KEV | Added: 2026-11-10 | Due:   
  2026-11-24

P205  NERD-TEXT 205   12.11.26 14:49 UTC
========================================
SECURITY ADVISORY (5/5)                 
========================================
> UBUNTU USN                            
  Ubuntu/USN: Yodl DoS Flaw Patched     
                                        
  Canonical released advisory USN-9063-1
  resolving a buffer over-read in Yodl. 
  Crafted input can trigger an          
  application crash, causing a denial of
  service. Users should update installed
  packages now.                         
                                        
  Source: Ubuntu USN (Wed, 11 Nov 2026)
